tasks.title: Email about choosing local suppliers
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.subject: Choosing local suppliers for our shop
paragraphs: As you know, our school shop is planning to start buying from local suppliers instead of big companies. I need your help to decide on a few things.
First, should we choose local suppliers because the food is fresher, or because it helps small businesses in our area? Which reason do you think is more important?
Also, we need to choose one product to buy locally first. Would you prefer to start with fresh bread or seasonal vegetables?
Finally, can you suggest one way to tell customers that we now use local suppliers?

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for your reply
listItems: Say which reason you prefer (fresher food OR helping small businesses) and explain why.
Choose a product to start with (bread OR vegetables) and give a reason.
Suggest one way to tell customers about the change.
Ask Mrs Hill about the delivery day for the local products.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Mrs Hill using all the notes.

tasks.title: Article about local suppliers
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: Our town magazine wants to hear your opinion about shops choosing local suppliers.
Do you think it is a good idea for shops to buy from local farmers and producers?
What is the most important reason for a shop to choose local suppliers?
Write an article answering these questions and we will put it in the next magazine!

tasks.title: Story about a local supplier
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.
Your story must begin with this sentence:
"When the programme coordinator opened the box of vegetables from the local farm, a small envelope fell out."
